initial_reasons.MARTY: He is already energized by the business display, leaning into the discovery with eager curiosity.
initial_reasons.DION: He presents the product with restrained pride, watching Marty closely for the recognition he has been waiting for.

MARTY.reason: The unexpected orange color produces an immediate burst of delighted surprise.
He connects the discovery to Dion's effort and turns his excitement toward him.
Hearing that Dion and his father believe in him touches the ambition beneath his excitement.
He excitedly recruits Rachel as a witness, checking whether she can share the significance of what he is seeing.
When Dion directs him to the packaging, he returns his attention to the physical product.
The originality of the orange-sphere concept lands on him with renewed amazement.
He rejects Dion's modest description and swells into emphatic admiration.
His amazement becomes almost overwhelming as he takes in the professional result.
Discovering that Dion personally drew the design shifts his attention from the package to Dion.
He treats Dion's design as genuinely visionary rather than merely competent.
He swings back to the packaging, eager to keep displaying the achievement.

DION.reason: Marty's recognition briefly relieves Dion's accumulated frustration and confirms that the work mattered.
He reveals the financial commitment with proud insistence, making clear that his family has backed Marty.
He eagerly redirects Marty to the packaging, proud to reveal the full scope of what he made.
He cautiously asks for confirmation, exposing how much he needs Marty to validate the design.
He adds the hand-drawn detail with a small, pleased flourish, offering another piece of himself for Marty to appreciate.
Marty's astonishment confirms that the personal labor behind the package has finally been seen.
He accepts the praise modestly, pleased but still slightly guarded after months of being overlooked.
Marty's deeper affirmation lands as meaningful recognition of Dion's creative potential.
He answers with sincere gratitude, allowing himself to enjoy the recognition.
